svg.aria-label: Left: the angles (s, d) of a missing south wing; the wall of Lemma 9.42 excludes s <= d - pi/4 (grey); the dashed lines s = 0, 2/5 and 12/25 bound the angles of S on its own axis and on the south side of C and split Propositions D.11 and D.12. Right: the angles (v, d) of a missing west wing with W on its own axis: the wall v <= pi/4 - d (grey), the gap q = d + v <= 1 of Lemma D.5 (yellow), and the four parts of Proposition D.7, each shaded in blue by the profile of its stress, which is positive throughout; they leave the small green domain of section D.9, with the three points of Lemma D.18 marked

shading: the profile of the stress of each part
